spanish: Y fue: varones que eran impuros a alma de adam, y no pudieron hacer el Pésaj en el día aquel; y se acercaron delante de Moisés y delante de Aarón en el día aquel.

findings.issue: אָדָם is a common noun (HNcmsa), not a proper name; “adam” leaves the lemma untranslated.
הַפֶּסַח is a common noun with the article (HTd/Ncmsa), not a locked proper name; “Pésaj” is an untranslated lemma with title capitalization.

notes: Moisés and Aarón match locked names; number, person, and the repeated “en el día aquel” stay with the tokens.
